name: DwarfStar / ds4
description: Run a focused native inference engine and coding agent for selected large models on consumer hardware.
compatibility: Metal, CUDA, and ROCm backends; native coding agent and HTTP server.
OpenAI-style Chat Completions, Responses, and Completions; Anthropic-style Messages.
limitations: Beta-quality software with fast-changing model support; uses project-produced GGUF files, not arbitrary GGUF models.
Metal primarily targets Macs with 96 GB or more; smaller machines and larger models may need SSD streaming.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
Documents serving endpoints, streaming, tool calls, and session limits.
